ABOUT ONE LEVER LABS

Technology for
everyday life.

One Lever Labs LLC is a technology company based in New Jersey, United States, founded on October 1, 2026.

We develop our own products for different everyday needs, including fitness and plant care. Our focus is on useful software with a clear purpose, helping people bring technology into the things they already care about.

Our work spans utility applications for Android and Apple platforms, web services, and games. Ferna, our plant-care application, is currently in development.

For company inquiries or questions about our software, contact abhijeet@oneleverlabs.com.
